what: run-to-run noise floor of one benchmark cell
why_these_are_true_replicates: train.seed in configs/base.yaml is never consumed: there is no torch.manual_seed anywhere in the training path (documented at unified/utils/checkpoint.py:127). Adapter init and the augmentation stream therefore differ per process, so repeats of one config are independent replicates, not cudnn-nondeterminism twins.
statistic: best val mean_dice over the run (gt-present averaging), the benchmark's own statistic
scope_limit: Measured in ONE cell, frozen at 25%. Only the 9.2M adapter+head params move here. Fine-tuned cells train the whole encoder and are expected to be noisier; this sigma must NOT be transferred to ft cells (notably the scratch-vs-pretrained comparison).
